【Product Color】: Natural (Original Wood Bamboo Color)
【Product Material】: Bamboo

Features:
1. Premium Natural Bamboo Material – Eco Friendly, Durable, and Comfortable
Made from carefully selected and polished natural bamboo, each tee showcases the distinct, natural grain of bamboo, giving it a unique texture. The eco friendly, biodegradable material is long lasting, resisting breakage or deformation, and delivers a consistently reliable tee off experience.

2. Six Standard Sizes to Match Different Swing Heights and Course Conditions
Available in six precise sizes: 32mm, 38mm, 45mm, 51mm, 56mm, and 70mm. You can choose the tee height that best suits your swing style, club type, and turf conditions to optimize launch angle and improve your driving performance.

3. Four Claw Wide Cup Top Design for Stable Ball Placement
Featuring a unique four claw design with a wide cup shaped top that securely cradles the golf ball, preventing it from rolling or wobbling before impact. This provides exceptional stability, ensuring every drive starts from a precisely positioned ball.

4. Adjustable Insertion Depth for Precise Ball Height Control
Thanks to the sturdy nature of bamboo, the tee offers depth controllable functionality. You can precisely adjust how deeply the tee is inserted into the ground based on personal preference and course conditions, allowing flexible ball height tuning to optimize your strike angle.

5. Fine Hand Polished Finish – Smooth and Safe to Use
Every tee is meticulously hand finished to a smooth surface free of rough edges. This not only makes the tee easy to insert and remove from the ground but, more importantly, protects your valuable golf balls and clubfaces from scratches, ensuring a safe and worry free experience.

Packing list：
50*Golf Positioning Nails
